Platform Technologies Engineer

San Francisco, CA

About the role

We are looking for a Platform Technologies Engineer to help us build the shared infrastructure that keeps the raincoat pipeline running. You will own the systems that move candidate data between our ATS integrations and internal stores.

What you will do

  • Design and maintain the ingestion pipeline that normalizes job postings at scale.
  • Partner with the integrations team to keep Greenhouse and Lever boards in sync.
  • Own the test harness and CI gates for the extraction service.
  • Drive reliability work: retries, circuit breakers, and observability.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years building backend systems with Python.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and queue-based workers.
  • Comfortable owning production services end to end.

Nice to have

  • Previous work on ATS or HR-tech platforms.
  • Familiarity with Greenhouse and Lever public APIs.
